# 0x0800 SRL |Denis Leclercq

> Cloud & AI architect and builder | NIS2, Private AI, Sovereign Cloud, Fractional CTO

## About

Denis Leclercq is a Cloud & AI architect and builder based in Liège, Belgium, operating through 0x0800 SRL (BCE: BE1021845609). 20 years of infrastructure, from bare-metal server rooms to sovereign cloud. He advises DSI, CTO and engineering teams on resilient sovereign architectures, NIS2/ISO27001 compliance, Cloud Drift remediation, and private/local AI — and ships his own products (CompliMetric, Hygur).

## Services

- NIS2 Compliance Audit: Infrastructure audit with continuous compliance verification via IaC and Drift Detection.
- Cloud Drift Detection & Remediation: Mapping gaps between IaC (Terraform) and actual cloud state (AWS, Azure, OVH). Remediation plan in 10 days.
- Private & Local AI Deployment: On-premise/VPC LLM deployment so teams can use AI without exposing data to public APIs.
- FinOps Optimization: Cloud cost control in a context of energy inflation and budget pressure.
- Sovereign Cloud Architecture: Multi-cloud/sovereign cloud architectures decoupled from geopolitical risks.
- Fractional CTO: Transitional technical leadership — senior architecture and delivery on tap.

## Products

- CompliMetric (https://complimetric.com): Continuous cloud compliance. Scans cloud and IaC, detects drift, produces NIS2/ISO 27001 evidence. SaaS + GitHub Action + MCP server.
- Hygur (https://hygur.ai): Local-first personal AI. Data stays on your machine, the model comes to it. Local edition and multi-tenant sovereign cloud.

## Expertise

20 years of infrastructure experience, from bare-metal server rooms to cloud-native architectures. AWS, Azure, OVH, Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevSecOps.
